name: Iran, Islamic Rep.
headline: Iran, Islamic Rep.: −0.9% growth in 2025, 50.6% inflation, debt 36% of GDP
sections: Iran, Islamic Rep. is a $371 billion economy (2025), the world's 44th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew −0.9% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $20K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 20.6% of GDP (2024).

Consumer prices rose 50.6% in 2025, well above typical central bank targets, up from 45.8% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 7.5% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 21.9% (2025).
Gross government debt is 36% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 47% in 2020. The general government balance is −5.3% of GDP (2025), a deficit beyond the common 3% benchmark.
The current account balance is +3.3% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 60% of GDP (2025), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 0.5% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 43% of GDP by 2031, still rising from today's level. Life expectancy is 77.9 years (2024). Population: 87.1 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
